[
  "The guideline corpus covers melanoma (MEL).",
  "According to the guidelines (aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-excision-first-line), surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.",
  "According to the same guidelines, surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "According to the guidelines (aad:pmid:30392755:table-x-slnb-timing), sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and in the same operative setting whenever possible.",
  "According to eado:pmid:39709737:recommendation-1, when melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "According to the same recommendation, incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.",
  "The consensus rate for recommendation 1 is 100 % (21/21)."
]
